title: Part 10: how 'not required' and 'did not run' are recorded
context: GateResult has only passed/inconclusive (core/types/verification.ts:28). Evidence gates and ledger rows already have a 'skipped' status (verification-evidence.ts:8, evidence-ledger.ts:32), the receipt statement already ignores skipped rows (statement.ts:43), and the HUD already maps skipped to not-required (snapshot.ts:233-253). But skipped mixes two meanings, and many gates (mutation, instructions-docs-structure, module-docs-structure, extension-surface, duplication, visual not-frontend, rules-loaded) still report a pass with nothing to check.

options.label: Reuse 'skipped' and add one field, skip_kind: 'not-required' | 'did-not-run', on gate results, evidence gates and ledger rows; GateResult gains outcome?: 'not-required'|'did-not-run' with passed:true so the runner never treats it as a failure; every count already ignores skipped
